title: Gaming and Livestreaming: Connecting While Distancing

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Since social distancing measures were first put in place, time spent gaming has gone up—way up.
reader_summary.overview: Since social distancing measures were first put in place, time spent gaming has gone up—way up. According to a recent report by Verizon, video game usage in the U.S. has risen 75 percent during peak hours.

key_points.text: The "stay at home" movement has given way to an upswell of new and returning gamers—as well as new challenges.
In this episode, a16z partner Jon Lai joins host Lauren Murrow to talk about how game developers are grappling with skyrocketing numbers.
